nodes.name: Boost.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the damage boost subsystem: BoostContext/BoostDef interfaces, the BOOST_DEFS registry (~40 conditional damage boosts keyed by perk name) with per-perk multipliers and custom calc functions, the BOOST_DEF_MAP lookup, helper calcs (calcMinionAbsorptionPotency, calcFrenzyPct), and Penance constants.

nodes.name: calcMinionAbsorptionPotency
nodes.summary: Computes the Minion Absorption damage-boost potency from summon boost percent and stack count, rounded to 4 decimals.

nodes.name: calcFrenzyPct
nodes.summary: Calculates the Frenzy damage percentage from rage potency using FRENZY_BASE and FRENZY_RAGE_MULT.

nodes.name: BoostContext
nodes.summary: Interface passed to custom boost calc functions containing perk amounts, crit/jump/summon/rage details, darkness/environment, HP fills, weapon art, and enemy HP info.

nodes.name: BoostDef
nodes.summary: Interface describing each boost entry: sourceName, damage/heal type, multiplier per perk, condition, appliesTo attack types, proc scaling, and optional custom calcFn.

nodes.name: BOOST_DEFS
nodes.summary: Registry (array) of all conditional damage boosts: Blood Thirsty, Venom Spitter, Perfection, Stealth, Golden Crits, Primal, Frenzy, Vampire, Penance, Deltabit, Level Damage, etc.

nodes.name: BOOST_DEF_MAP
nodes.summary: Map built from BOOST_DEFS keyed by sourceName for fast O(1) boost lookups.

nodes.name: BuffData.ts
nodes.summary: Core buff/debuff data module: defines BuffDefinition/GrantedBuff schemas, BUFF_DEFS registry, item/perk/weapon-art buff maps and factories, True Balance conversions, Darkening Hex logic, and the active-buff assembly pipeline (getPerkBuffs, getActiveBuildBuffs, assembleActiveBuffs, applyBuffPerkModifiers).

nodes.name: getWeaponArtBuffs
nodes.summary: Returns the GrantedBuff list that a Weapon Art grants from WEAPON_ART_BUFF_MAP.

nodes.name: getTrueBalanceBuffs
nodes.summary: Converts active debuffs into True Balance buffs (e.g. Slowness -> Tailwind, Weakness -> Rage) using TRUE_BALANCE_DEBUFF_MAP, grouping by target and taking max potency/duration.

nodes.name: hasEligibleDarkeningHexSource
nodes.summary: Determines whether any perk/weapon/WA dmg type qualifies as a hex source that triggers Darkening Hex.

nodes.name: applyDarkeningHexPotency
nodes.summary: Applies the Darkening Hex potency transform (potency*mult^n + add*mult*(mult^n-1)/(mult-1)) given perk amount and activation count.

nodes.name: applyBuffPerkModifiers
nodes.summary: Applies per-buff modifier logic: Darkening Hex bolster, specific/bastion/trickster/generic debuff modifiers, duration multipliers, truncating and leaving final potency/bonus fields.

nodes.name: applyToxinTransferDuration
nodes.summary: Extends Toxin Transfer poison durations to the longest self-applied poison duration plus the toxin extra window.

nodes.name: convertTailwindToWhirlwind
nodes.summary: Relabels Tailwind buffs as Whirlwind (scaling duration with Bounce stacks) and appends a Bleed granted by Whirlwind perk.

nodes.name: getPerkBuffs
nodes.summary: Iterates the perks map and returns all buffs granted by PERK_BUFFS factories for each positive perk amount, rounding durations.

nodes.name: getActiveBuildBuffs
nodes.summary: Collects GrantedBuffs from all equipped item slots (rune, ring, armor, weapon, glove) plus race buffs via the item-slot lookup.

nodes.name: assembleActiveBuffs
nodes.summary: Pipeline that merges item, potion, perk and weapon-art buffs, applies perk modifiers via applyBuffPerkModifiers, converts Tailwind to Whirlwind, then applies Cauterize conversion.

nodes.name: applyCauterizeConversion
nodes.summary: Marks enemy Burn entries with burnMode:'singed' when Cauterize is active and Cursed Flames is not.

nodes.name: getBurnApplicationCount
nodes.summary: Returns how many Burn application entries exist in a buff list, used to scale singed burst damage.

nodes.name: getBuffDescription
nodes.summary: Computes the user-facing description for a buff from static/dynamic text, special-casing Weakness/Shatter/Anti Heal formulas.

nodes.name: calcBuffEffect
nodes.summary: Computes a buff's effect value/unit (%/flat) from effectPerTenthPotency and potency, returning a short label.

nodes.name: formatPerkDescription
nodes.summary: Replaces x%-placeholder in a perk description with the computed potency display value.

nodes.name: BuffDefinition
nodes.summary: Schema describing a buff: name, color, static/dynamic description, effectPerTenthPotency, unit, statKey, and flags for debuff/self-debuff/neutral.

nodes.name: GrantedBuff
nodes.summary: Schema of an applied buff/debuff instance: buffName, potency, duration, condition, source and source type.

nodes.name: ActiveBuffsBuildInput
nodes.summary: Input shape passed to assembleActiveBuffs listing equipped build slots, weapon art, potions, and Darkening Hex options.

nodes.name: BUFF_DEFS
nodes.summary: Registry of BuffDefinitions for all named game buffs/debuffs incl. Rage, Regen, Reinforce, Weakness, Bleed, Burn, Poison, Shatter, etc.

nodes.name: PERK_BUFFS
nodes.summary: Factory map from perk name to GrantedBuff-list producers, consumed by getPerkBuffs.

nodes.name: ITEM_BUFF_MAP
nodes.summary: Table of rune/potion/item GrantedBuffs used by getActiveBuildBuffs slot lookups.

nodes.name: WEAPON_ART_BUFF_MAP
nodes.summary: Map of Weapon Art -> GrantedBuff list, read by getWeaponArtBuffs.

nodes.name: TRUE_BALANCE_DEBUFF_MAP
nodes.summary: Mapping of debuff -> True Balance granted buff with potency/duration formulas, consumed by getTrueBalanceBuffs.

nodes.name: perkAutoDebuffs.ts
nodes.summary: Automatically derives which enemy debuffs a build applies from its perks and state: exports calcActualHpFillPct and getAutoDebuffs (Exhaust burn, Penance bleed, Frostbite slow, Venom, Cursor Blades, Hypnotist, Cryo Engine slice conversion, etc.).

nodes.name: calcActualHpFillPct
nodes.summary: Computes effective HP fill, rescaling raw fill against adjusted max HP from protection and capping at 100%.

nodes.name: getAutoDebuffs
nodes.summary: Builds the granted debuff list by checking each conditional perk against existing buffs, perks, HP gates and proc coefficients; merges enemy-HP debuffs via getActiveEnemyHpDebuffs, then applies Cryo Engine Slowness-to-Frostbite conversion.

nodes.name: AutoDebuffInput
nodes.summary: Input data for getAutoDebuffs: existing/player buff names, perks, hpFill/level/protection, WA proc coefficients, enemy HP fill, and magic dmg flags.

nodes.name: buffs.ts
nodes.summary: Constants module of buff/debuff potencies and durations: potion, rune, weapon-art and perk-derived buff values consumed by BuffData.

nodes.name: perk-base-damage.ts
nodes.summary: Constants module with base damage and per-stack damage for perk abilities (Perkwheel/Balistad/Spirit summons, etc.), consumed by perkAutoDebuffs and others.

nodes.name: perks.ts
nodes.summary: Constants module for perk multipliers, crit rates and special perk coefficients (e.g. Sunburn, Cryno Engine, Hypnotist, Darkening Hex).

nodes.name: storage.ts
nodes.summary: Constants for localStorage keys, BUILD_STATE_DEFAULTS default build snapshot, save key mapping, and build slot counts.
